gloss: anyway; in any case; at any rate

definitions.gloss: anyway; in any case; at any rate
definitions.explanation: Used to shift focus or move on to the main point, regardless of what was discussed before.

examples.japanese: ともあれ、まず{試|ため}してみよう。
{理由|りゆう}はともあれ、{結果|けっか}は{良|よ}かった。
examples.english: Whatever the reason, the result was good.

examples.japanese: ともあれ、{無事|ぶじ}で{何|なに}よりだ。
examples.english: At any rate, I'm glad you're safe.

notes:
USAGE:
ともあれ is a conjunction/adverb used to:
1. Move on from a previous topic to the main point
2. Set aside certain factors to focus on what matters

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
・とにかく (anyway - more casual, emphatic)
・いずれにせよ (in any case - formal)
・{何|なに}はともあれ (whatever happens, first of all)

REGISTER:
Slightly formal; common in both written and spoken Japanese.
